mapping.summary: Reusable mandatory checklists attached to documents and master data
claims: No-code checklist template designer with groups, headlines and mandatory/normal/additional items
Checklists auto-attach to records by filter
Usable on master-data pages and on manufacturing, project, service, purchase and sales pages
Field lines write back to the record with BC validation
Release with open mandatory items: allow, warn or block
Editor for checklists offering text areas, dropdowns, toggles and drop zones for images
Checklists carry over from quote to order and on posting
Print or save checklist as PDF report
Export/import templates as JSON and copy from another company
Spans more than 30 pages for documents and master data
Service and Manufacturing areas require Premium
